transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

Lately, I've been having a really hard time because I feel like I just can't listen properly when people are talking directly to me. Even when I'm trying my best to pay attention, my mind just drifts off, and it's starting to cause some real issues in my daily life.
Have these attention problems been present since childhood, or did they start more recently during a stressful time or along with feeling anxious or depressed?

They have definitely been present since I was a kid, well before I turned 12. It's not something that just started recently because of stress or feeling anxious, as I've struggled with this for as long as I can remember.
Do these attention problems happen in more than one setting, like both at work or school and at home, and have they caused problems in those areas?

Yes, they definitely happen in both settings. At home, I really struggle to finish simple chores, and at work, I constantly fail to follow through on instructions or finish my projects. It has definitely caused a lot of problems in both areas of my life.
Besides trouble listening, do you often make careless mistakes, lose things, get easily distracted, or forget daily tasks?
No, I wouldn't say I really struggle with those specific things. I don't often lose my belongings or make careless mistakes, and I'm usually able to keep track of my daily tasks.
Do you often have trouble staying focused on tasks like reading or paperwork, or avoid them because they take a lot of mental effort?
No, I haven't really noticed that being a major issue for me. I don't typically avoid tasks or paperwork just because they require a lot of mental effort.
When you don’t finish chores or work projects, is it mainly because your attention drifts while doing them, even if you want to complete them?

Yes, that's exactly what happens. Even when I fully intend to finish a chore or a work project, my mind just drifts off and I get distracted halfway through. I really want to complete them, but I just lose focus and leave them unfinished.
Do you often have trouble organizing tasks or activities, like planning steps, managing time, or keeping your work in order?
I don't really have major issues with organizing or managing my time. Keeping my things in order or planning out steps hasn't really been a significant problem for me.
When someone is speaking to you directly, does your mind drift even when there are no obvious distractions and you’re interested in what they’re saying?

Yes, that happens very frequently. Even when I'm genuinely interested and there are no distractions around, my mind just drifts off while someone is talking directly to me. It often gets to the point where I have to ask them to repeat themselves entirely.
Do you also often feel restless or fidgety, have trouble sitting still, talk excessively, or act impulsively, or is it mainly the attention problems?

It is definitely a mix of both attention issues and physical restlessness. I often find myself fidgeting, tapping my hands or feet, or squirming in my seat when I'm supposed to sit still. I also have a bad habit of interrupting others and butting into conversations.
Besides fidgeting and interrupting, do you often feel driven to be constantly active, leave your seat when expected to stay seated, or have trouble waiting your turn?

No, I don't really experience those specific things. I don't feel like I'm constantly on the go, I don't leave my seat unexpectedly, and I don't have trouble waiting my turn. My restlessness is really just limited to the fidgeting and interrupting I mentioned earlier.

Given clinically significant symptoms from both domains with cross-situational impairment, Combined Presentation is the best fit among the provided options.
